hero.badge: Free • No account needed • Zero data stored
hero.subtitle: Drop any file. Get a permanent, Bitcoin-backed timestamp. Valid in court. No lawyers. No trust required.
hero.description: Satohash hashes your file locally in your browser — your document never leaves your device. Only a cryptographic fingerprint gets written to the Bitcoin blockchain, creating immutable proof of existence for any file, contract, photo, or dataset.
hero.socialProof: Join {{count}} professionals anchoring documents to Bitcoin

features.titleLine1: You Already Trust Bitcoin With Value.
features.subtitle: When Satoshi Nakamoto launched Bitcoin in 2009, he embedded a newspaper headline in the genesis block — proof it wasn't pre-mined. That same power is now yours, for any document, in minutes.

noServer.title: No Server Required
noServer.body: Your document never leaves your device. We only see a cryptographic hash — like a fingerprint, not the actual file. Zero-knowledge by design.

anchored.title: Anchored in 60 Minutes
anchored.body: Within one Bitcoin block, your proof is woven into the chain. Every node on Earth validates it. It cannot be altered, backdated, or deleted.

court.title: Independently Verifiable Evidence
court.body: Satohash proofs are independently verifiable electronic evidence of existence-at-a-time, aligned with the framework of the ESIGN Act (US), UETA, and eIDAS (EU).

noMiddleman.title: No Middleman. Ever.
noMiddleman.body: Unlike traditional notaries, there's no company to shut down, no server to hack. Bitcoin itself is the notary — 18,000 full nodes strong.

howItWorks.subtitle: From file to Bitcoin in under an hour. No account required to try it.

upload.title: Upload or Hash Your File
upload.body: Drag any document into Satohash. We instantly generate a SHA-256 fingerprint in your browser. Your file never leaves your device.

anchor.title: Anchor to Bitcoin
anchor.body: Your fingerprint is submitted to the Bitcoin blockchain via OpenTimestamps. Embedded in the next block — typically within 60 minutes.

certificate.title: Download Your Certificate
certificate.body: Receive a portable proof certificate. Independently verifiable anywhere, anytime — even if Satohash ceases to exist.

howItWorks.privacyTitle: Your files never leave your device
howItWorks.privacyBody: Satohash only sees a SHA-256 hash — never your original document. Zero-knowledge by design.

useCases.title: Who Needs Proof That Can't Be Faked?

legal.title: Legal Contracts
legal.body: Prove your contract existed before a dispute. No he-said-she-said in court.

creative.title: Creative Work
creative.body: Photographers, writers, designers — timestamp before you publish. Your priority is proven.

medical.title: Medical Records
medical.body: Immutable audit trails for patient documents and treatment history.

corporate.title: Corporate Compliance
corporate.body: Board resolutions, financials, audit logs — cryptographic integrity, always.

research.title: Research & IP
research.body: Scientists and inventors prove discovery dates with mathematical certainty.

government.title: Government & Archives
government.body: Public records that can never be altered or backdated — ever.

freeModel.explainer: We free-timestamp a fingerprint of your file using OpenTimestamps on Bitcoin. The free base tier is the permanent, never-paywalled trust anchor; optional premium tiers and a pay-per-use API are built and staged and launch paid only once the Lightning rails are funded and tested.
freeModel.chainNote: Chain: Bitcoin only (via OpenTimestamps). Your file stays on your device — we only handle the hash.
freeModel.futureSubtitle: Same proofs, same Bitcoin anchor. Free base (never paywalled) + optional premium tiers (Professional ~2,100 sats/mo, Business ~21,000 sats/mo) + pay-per-use API (1–5 sats/stamp). Launches paid only when rails are funded and tested.

free.name: Free
free.desc: Unlimited stamp & verify with OpenTimestamps. No account. No Lightning invoice. Never paywalled (trust anchor).

sats.name: Professional
sats.desc: Optional premium tier (built, staged). Individual high-volume stamping. Collection depends on Lightning channels being funded.

pro.name: Business / Studio
pro.desc: Optional premium tier (built, staged). Teams and studios. Enterprise (custom) is partner-gated and not marketed now.

finalCta.subtitle: No account required. No credit card. Your first proof is free. Anchored to Bitcoin in under an hour.

donation.title: Support Satohash
donation.subtitle: Keep timestamps free for everyone
donation.thanks: Every satoshi helps keep timestamps free. Thank you. 🙏
